Daily Devotional

January 30

10 For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death. (2 Corinthians 7:10 KJV)

The Godly type of sorrow is a feeling of sorrow that you have sinned against God and people, and if you repent (turn from) this type of sin, then it will lead you to salvation. This type of sorrow is a heartfelt sorrow that you truly regret what you have done to others, and wish you could make it right again. You must realize that you are a sinner (Romans 3:23), in order to be able to be saved, as salvation is for the ungodly and unrighteous, and not for the righteous person (Matthew 9:13). If you don’t know you are a sinner, then you can’t have a godly sorrow that will lead to salvation. Praise God that Jesus came for us sinners.

If you are only sorry that you got caught committing a sin, then you are only thinking about yourself, and what might happen to you. If it is all about you, and the consequences that it will bring into your life, then it will only work death, and not lead you to repentance for salvation. This present generation is what I call the “me generation”, as it is all about what we want, and what we can get, and problems are always someone else’s fault, and not about putting your neighbor’s needs above your own (James 2:8). Once you get born again, and have the fruit of the Spirit in you (Galatians 5:22-23), then you will have God’s love, and that is what you need to be able to love others as much as you love yourself. Praise God for the fruit of the Spirit.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
